name: Vishal Patel
tagline: Engineering repeatable, reliable systems that bridge AI decision pipelines and visual software experiences.

philosophy.description: Understand systemic inefficiencies and patterns in existing environments.
Examine state-of-the-art architectures and alternative algorithmic solutions.
Map logical dependencies, schema constraints, and pipeline layouts.
Prototype models and sandbox endpoints to validate system assumptions.
Write clean, type-safe, and modular code optimized for performance.
Ship containerized services with continuous telemetry and monitoring.
Refine throughput, reduce response latencies, and prune parameters.
Incorporate feedback loops and update systemic parameters.
